$comment: PR-size budget (scripts/pr-size.mjs). Review is only real when a reviewer can read the whole diff; a PR bigger than this needs the `size-exception` label, which is owner sign-off. Ratchet: tighten freely, loosen only with owner sign-off. Lines = added + deleted, from `git diff --numstat -M`. Calibrated 2026-09-04 on the last 30 merged PRs: chatterbuilt median 36 / p90 6489, the-gibson median 398, conference-os median 107.
